title: Supporting the Kimberley: Major Grants to Two Worthy Charities
author: Ian
body:
The APT Travel Group have been touring through the Kimberley region for many years, operating 4WD drive tours, cruises and welcoming guests to their lodges. ATG are committed to giving back to the region through the APT Foundation and their charity partner the Wunan Foundation.

The APT Foundation recently donated $20,000 to the Wunan Foundation based in Kununurra, to support the launch of the First Jobs program which supports indigenous youth. Wunan believes that success for an individual, is defined by having their finances, relationships and health in order. Wunan in partnership with the APT Foundation are committed

to providing long term solutions in education training and employment for Aboriginal people in the East Kimberley by delivering services aimed at supporting people to transition directly into real jobs and get ‘job ready’ by undertaking vocational training.

Learn more about Wunan Foundation and how you can support here.

Along with the donation to Wunan, the APT Foundation also granted the Imintji Arts Centre $12,501 to purchase new heavy duty outdoor tables and chairs. The upgrade of infrastructure was essential and will benefit the community and the travellers they welcome in a positive way.

A feature of the Imintji Arts Centre is that travellers are invited to sit with the Artists while they paint and learn about their culture and listen to the stories behind the art work. All income from the Imintji centre is used to support the community.
